Crime & Law · India

Bodies Exhumed and DGP Found Dead in Separate Incidents

In Karnataka, the body of a teenage girl was exhumed following a confession by the accused's uncle. Separately, the body of a paramedical student was found in his Bengaluru home, with police investigating the cause of death, though suicide is suspected. In Tripura, Director General of Police Anurag Dhankar was found dead at the state police headquarters in Agartala. Another incident in Chandigarh involved a domestic worker found dead in her employer's home, with suicide also suspected.
